SELECT id, supplier_status AS supplierStatus, supplier_name AS supplierName, phone_number AS phoneNumber, supplier_email AS supplierEmail, initial_oping AS initialOping, taxpayer_identification_number AS taxpayerIdentificationNumber, open_bank AS openBank, address, remake, contact_person AS contactPerson, contact_number AS contactNumber, supplier_fax AS supplierFax, last_oping AS lastOping, tax_rate AS taxRate, account, sort_value AS sortValue FROM s_supplier_info WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND supplier_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.supplierName}, '%')
AND phone_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.phoneNumber}, '%')
AND contact_person LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.contactPerson}, '%')
ORDER BY sort_value ASC, create_time DESC
